blob47.rule: a diagonal bit counts only when both adjacent orthogonal bits are set
blob47.fileSuffix: zero-padded decimal canonical mask, e.g. water-shore-017.svg
blob47.neighbourOutsideSet: a neighbour in the set (bit = 1) means the tile continues across that edge

fogEdge.note: bit set = fog hugs that side; mask 0 is empty so it is omitted
